name.description:
If no fields are populated on the Genai.LlmGuardrails.Processor, it will not be correctly persisted on
{@link Genai.LlmGuardrails.Manager#inputProcessors} or {@link Genai.LlmGuardrails.Manager#outputProcessors},
so this field exists to ensure that all processors are correctly persisted.

promptParamsToScan.description: The values of {@link Genai.Prompt#params} to scan.

threshold.description:
Threshold for detecting toxicity. LLM Guard use threshold values to evaluate the risk score of the text being scanned.
It's a numeric parameter that sets the sensitivity level for detecting unwanted content, such as toxicity, bias, or other harmful outputs.
Default threshold values provided by LLM Guard or based on industry standards is 0.5.
Please refer https://llm-guard.com/get_started/quickstart/ for more details.

title:
Toxic processor is an input processor which detects toxic or malicious inputs that may alter the AI model's intended behavior.
 and ensure that only safe and appropriate inputs are processed, protecting the system from exploitation.
